existingTransitionSource.boundary: The projection is state-based and source-derived; it does not execute transitions or yet bind the transition view to every operation-specific handler.

reconciliationFindings: M627 directly proves packaged visibility of the exact core transition projection and preserves the no-write/no-authority boundary.

M625 and M627 prove the core transition vocabulary is projected without semantic drift, but the current projection is keyed only by history state and is not cross-bound to each operation-specific handler.

No packaged or local action in M627 proves transition execution, authoritative reread, undo/redo, stale/timeout recovery, commit, or aggregate active-GM/Foundry authority across the eleven producer families.
Stage 11 acceptance remains blocked by distributed lifecycle evidence rather than by missing transition vocabulary visibility.
remainingGaps: The exact 14 operation handlers are not yet cross-bound to the 11-state transition projection in one typed read-only matrix.
Cross-producer transition, authoritative reread, undo/redo, stale/timeout recovery, commit, and aggregate authority evidence remain distributed.
Broader recovery/cleanup remains separately gated and cannot be inferred from read-only projection metadata.
Technical Builder/repository and active-GM/Foundry authority remain distinct boundaries.
reconciliation.smallestRemainingGap: A typed, read-only, non-certifying operation-to-history-transition coverage matrix derived from the existing 14 operation handlers and exact core 11-state transition projection, with no execution or authority change.

decision.reason: M628 preserves the direct packaged transition-projection pass and confirms the existing core source. All four Stage 11 clauses remain partial because operation-specific lifecycle binding and runtime/aggregate evidence are not complete.

selectedNextBoundary.title: Stage 11 typed operation-to-history-transition coverage matrix
selectedNextBoundary.scope: Add a typed, read-only, non-certifying matrix that binds each existing exact 14-operation handler to the existing 11-state core transition projection, and add focused deterministic/static tests. Preserve exact handlers and transition semantics; add no executor, transition call, persistence, recovery, or authority. No build, launch, capture, UI action, Stage 11 acceptance, or Stage 12 work is authorized in M629.
